explication: Laya is a local-first AI notification command center: connected work tools feed normalized events into the Python engine, which classifies and enriches them into reviewable Action Cards; users then approve, dismiss, investigate, or act on those cards in the desktop UI. The engine also supports search, chat, analytics, context learning, Omni summaries, workspaces, and outbound actions. The README documents the broad workflow; sampled source confirms selected ingestion, routing, agent-prompt, session, and egress behavior, so other subsystem wiring is shown only where documented.
